meta.title: Buka Skills
meta.description: Adds a Skills page to the sidebar: Installed lists the skills installed globally for every DSH session and uninstalls each through the right path, while Saved keeps a personal list of npx skills sources. Every saved repository is probed and expanded into a cached skills tree; each skill in it can be installed globally, into an agent, or into a registered workspace, and only the global action is disabled once that skill is installed globally.
